scope: Frozen equations from generated tiny S3/S4 systems; at most eight Boolean variables. Rebased and membership variants are paired, not independent trials.
monomial_order: graded lex, x_(n-1)>...>x_0; hex bit j is coefficient of mask j after sorting masks by (popcount, integer value)
omitted: Original curve metadata, field-rank probes, timings, and ideal-membership certificates are not replayed here. This corpus validates only the Boolean algebra and truncated-closure bound.
